title: Continuous sample drop flow microextraction: a versatile and green microextraction tool in analytical chemistry
content:

Continuous sample drop-flow microextraction (CSDF-ME) has become a powerful and versatile liquid-phase microextraction methodology that overcomes several of the analytical and environmental shortcomings of traditional sample preparation procedures.
